I am not someone who typically leaves reviews, but after multiple disappointing experiences at this PetSmart grooming location, I feel compelled to share my concerns.

I normally take my dog to the PetSmart in Richardson, where he has always received excellent grooming services. Unfortunately, my experiences at this location have been completely different.

Several months ago, I brought my dog in for grooming and was met by a groomer who was rude, unprofessional, and seemed focused on adding extra charges. After the grooming was completed, my dog’s haircut was uneven and did not meet expectations. I was told that the groomer had “tried his best” because my dog was allegedly attempting to bite him and was difficult to work with. This explanation did not make sense to me. My dog is extremely friendly, social, and has been groomed many times before without any behavioral issues. He loves people and has never shown aggression toward a groomer.

Today, June 7, 2026, I gave this location another chance. My dog had a scheduled grooming appointment at 2:45 PM. After driving approximately 30 minutes to the store, I was informed that my appointment would need to be rescheduled because my dog is large, has a thick coat, and was matted. While I understand that grooming a large Goldendoodle-Husky mix requires additional time, these are factors that should have been discussed before the appointment was accepted.

The groomer explained that her schedule was already full and that she would not have enough time to complete the service before closing. However, I do not believe that should become the customer’s problem after an appointment has already been scheduled. If coat condition, size, or grooming complexity affect scheduling, those questions should be asked during the booking process so customers are not inconvenienced after making arrangements and traveling to the store.

What was most disappointing was the lack of accountability and customer service. My appointment was effectively canceled upon arrival, I was not offered any meaningful accommodation, and there was little to no apology for the inconvenience. When I spoke with a manager, the only solution offered was to reschedule, despite being told that the grooming schedule was already fully booked.

I understand that grooming appointments can be challenging to manage, but customers deserve better communication, professionalism, and respect for their time. Unfortunately, based on my experiences, I cannot recommend this grooming location.
